name: Tax
overview: Scripture reveals that taxation was an established practice in ancient times, as seen in Genesis where Pharaoh appointed officers to collect a fifth of the land's produce during plentiful years, except for the priests' land which was exempt (Genesis 41:34, 41:48, 47:26). The Lord instructed Moses to require a personal ransom tax from each Israelite when numbering them, demonstrating that taxes were also a means of worship and atonement (Exodus 30:11-13). These passages show that taxes were both a civil obligation and a spiritual act, carefully regulated by God to maintain order and provision.
